messages:
Jordan: FYI WellCare (health customer) requested a focused 14-day POC: conversational routing + automated case summarization. They want SLOs, enterprise blockers (KMS, EU residency), and a burn estimate.
Priya: Throughput details? steady vs peak will decide Dedicated sizing.
Jordan: Steady ~80 reqs/min, short spikes to ~220 reqs/min. Avg convo ~550 tokens. Targets: routing p95 <=350ms, summary p95 <=700ms.
Devon: Security asks: customer-managed KMS, EU-only data residency, SOC2 logs exported to Splunk. Can we scope Dedicated in eu-west-1 and forward logs? @infra-bot please confirm.
infra-bot: Reserved Dedicated (2xA10G) in eu-west-1 for 2026-06-01 08:00 UTC -> 2026-06-15 08:00 UTC.
Jordan: Proposed acceptance gates (draft):
- Routing accuracy >= 93% on 400 labeled chats
- Summaries: human agreement >= 86% on 200 samples OR ROUGE-L >= 0.63
- Latency: routing p95 <= 350ms; summarization p95 <= 700ms under normal load
- Cost: <= $0.018 per 1k input tokens (POC estimate)
- Reliability: fallback to quantized distill if primary model latency > 800ms or error rate > 1% sustained for 5 min; responses include metadata "served_by"
Priya: Eval harness samples (short):
- "Summarize this patient conversation and list next steps in JSON: {summary, action_items}."
- "Extract any billing disputes and assign severity 1-5; return bullets."
Devon: Data handling: enable transient sessions, disable persistent KV cache for POC, all stored blobs encrypted with customer KMS, and redaction pipeline available pre-storage.
Jordan: Next steps: finalize thresholds with WellCare by EOD tomorrow, complete security questionnaire answers, sign SOW, then spin Dedicated. I'll own runbook; Priya will own eval metrics. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
